name: team_2014
caption:
IF THE 2014 WE-THE-NORTH STARTERS WERE POKÉMON 🎮🏀

🐷 Kyle Lowry = Pignite: when its fire flares up, it gets sharper and faster. 17.9 points and 7.4 assists a night
🦁 DeMar DeRozan = Litleo: the stronger the opponent, the more power it finds. 22.7 a night and his first All-Star game
🐦 Terrence Ross = Swellow: dives from far above, never misses. The dunk champ dropped 51 in one night
💪 Amir Johnson = Gurdurr: a group of wrestlers couldn't budge it. 56.2% from the field
🐘 Jonas Valanciunas = Donphan: its tackle can knock down a house. 8.8 rebounds a night

That's a team we're taking into any gym in the league. Who would you change? 👇

facts.claim: In April 2014 the Raptors unveiled the We The North campaign, launched in time for the 2014 playoffs
DeRozan's 2013-14 season was a breakout year with career-high 22.7 points; first All-Star selection in 2014 (6x NBA All-Star: 2014, 2016-2018, 2022, 2023)
Ross won the 2013 Slam Dunk Contest; on January 25, 2014, he scored a career-high and franchise-tying 51 points vs the Clippers
